title: Unreal 3 Raspberry & Tangerine 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Unreal 3’s Propical Raspberry & Tangerine flavour is a perfectly balanced blend of tangy, juicy raspberries and sweet, soothing tangerines, all swirled into crushed ice for truly epic refreshment. Any vaper who’s after fresh and fruity, exotic flavours should consider exploring the latest collection of Unreal 3 ‘Propical’ E-liquids. The wide array of unique tropical flavours blows away the rest of the competition, as a refreshing burst of sweetness is guaranteed with every puff. From tangy citrus aromas to the sweet tang of berries, Unreal 3 ‘Propical’ are a range of tropical island-inspired e-liquids that capture sunshine in every bottle. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle helps ensure your favourite e-liquid really goes the distance and comes with 20ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your juice’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods and sub-ohm tanks . Shortfills are ideal for vapers who know what flavours and e-liquid brands they love and always want a ready supply on hand. They offer a practical way to save money on your favourite e-liquids by reducing the need to frequently buy smaller quantities. Since their high-VG to PG ratio typically makes them suitable for use with high-powered devices, such vape kits often consume e-liquid faster than low-powered vape devices, so having a large bottle of your favourite e-liquid helps ensure you don’t run out too quickly.
